scope: Release-safe copy controls for Course 1 primary visuals 13-18.

rules: Visuals teach public academic course content and must not imply professional credential issuance.
Facility-specific procedures remain controlled by current SOPs, manufacturer instructions, labels, record systems, and authorized roles.
Technician I actions must remain explicitly assigned, trained, and authorized.

assets.title: Equipment Pre-Use and Readiness Checks
assets.coreMessage: Check the exact asset, controlled status, assigned external readiness points, permitted indicators, and final status before use.
assets.boundary: A failed readiness check is a reason to stop use, preserve controlled status, and follow the site-defined escalation process. It is not permission to diagnose or repair.

assets.title: Routine Operator Care versus Skilled Maintenance
assets.header: Course 1 • Module 5 • Operator vs. Maintenance Boundary
assets.coreMessage: Routine operator care exists only where the current equipment/site procedure explicitly assigns, trains, and authorizes the action.
assets.boundary: When the next step crosses into servicing or hazardous-energy work, preserve safe status and transfer the work to the trained and authorized role.

assets.title: Maintenance-Ready Fault Context
assets.coreMessage: Record the exact asset, time, alarm or symptom, permitted checks, recurrence, process impact, safe status, and notification.
assets.evidenceRule: Separate verified observations from hypotheses. Do not declare a root cause without authorized diagnostic evidence.
assets.boundary: Reporting timing and channel follow the applicable emergency, fault-reporting, or escalation procedure.

assets.title: Controlled Record Correction
assets.coreMessage: Correct records through the approved paper or digital process while preserving the original information or audit trail, attribution, timing, and reason when required.
assets.paperExample: Single-line strike-through, corrected entry, initials/date, and reason may be shown only as an illustrative paper-record method when the governing procedure permits it.
assets.boundary: The approved record system, facility SOP, and applicable requirements control the correction method.
prohibitedClaims: this is the required correction method

assets.title: Professional Shift Handoff
assets.coreMessage: Transfer current status, completed and open work, unresolved risks, notifications, next actions, timing, and ownership using exact identifiers.
assets.boundary: Transferred instructions and priorities must be current, controlled, and within the receiving worker's authority. Use cross-check/read-back for critical open items.
prohibitedClaims: incoming worker must follow verbal instruction even if undocumented

assets.title: Integrated Technician I Workflow
assets.coreMessage: Strong performance includes stopping, holding, preserving evidence, or escalating when the next action exceeds authority or the evidence is incomplete.
assets.boundary: Planning means reviewing assigned work, current instructions, dependencies, hazards, prerequisites, and priorities; it does not create independent production-planning or release authority.
